purpose: Correct the rejected v12 inventory trust, descriptor race, and sort identity designs without authorizing source access or execution.
threat_boundary: Hostile code already executing in the same Python interpreter is not a supported isolation boundary; the private test issuer is not a production API.

repair_rules.control: The zero-argument production factory refuses TRUST_ANCHORS_NOT_FINALIZED; no public API accepts roots, marker paths, digests, sort paths, or environment values.
repair_rules.logs: Linux POSIX descriptor-only traversal starts at slash, uses openat style dir_fd plus O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC, hashes one opened regular-file descriptor, and rejects symlink, special file, nonportable name and observed races with no fallback.
repair_rules.sort: SEALED_MEMFD_REQUIRED: a frozen absolute sort path, digest and exact version are required in a future trusted control. Verified source bytes are copied to a Linux sealed memfd before execution through /proc/self/fd with pass_fds and exactly LANG=en_US.UTF-8, never PATH or inherited environment.
